candidates.equivalent_settings_merged: DBN only: num_tempi when the tempo range has at most 30 frame intervals; meter_change_prob for a single meter
candidates.origin: every distinct setting of this decoder that the August searches of this experiment evaluated and that the ported decoder can run

notes: Parameters were selected on validation songs only. The decision to re-rank the searched settings instead of running a new search was taken after comparing both on the salsa specialist, including on its test songs.
reason: The August searches scored settings on stored features, whose frames are centred about 24 ms later than those of the live frontend, and a shared setting lets validation songs of one fold influence the setting used on them as test songs of another fold.

stage_config.activation_source: live scores of the ported engine: each fold model on that fold's validation songs, uncached streaming frontend
stage_config.aggregation: track mean per dataset, harmonic mean of beat and downbeat, mean over datasets
stage_config.decoder: ported decoder of mir-embedded-pp (host library); the particle filter uses the portable SplitMix64 generator with the per-track seed of the benchmark plan

supersedes: the shared August selection of this decoder, archived outside the repository on 6 October 2026
